## Checks
- [ ] Lint, type check and tests pass
- [ ] New logic was written test-first; bug fixes include a reproducing test
- [ ] New screens have empty, loading and error states
- [ ] UX review done (`/ux-review`)
- [ ] No secrets in code; RLS on new tables
- [ ] Auth changes checked with `/security-check` (token storage, server-side authorization, rate limits)
- [ ] Screenshots attached, if there are visual changes
